about: grid placement goes in declaration order from just after the previous child, leaving holes behind (probe-confirmed); a child spanning rows keeps those cells for later children (contract text, not measured); a spacer takes a cell and its row is 0 high (probe-confirmed); hidden and false children take no cell (contract text); fields of another container or child kind, bad tracks, spans and baseline in a grid or stack are refused (probe-confirmed: the refusals of oracle s25)
